metadata.title: HomeFund
metadata.description: Accounts, movements and balances shared between several people.
metadata.loginDescription: Sign in with a link sent to your email, no password needed.
metadata.onboardingDescription: A fund is the shared pot: its accounts, its members and its history.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.emptyDescription: Create a credential so a shortcut or a service records movements for you.
webhooks.rateLimit: {count, plural, one {# request per minute} other {# requests per minute}}
webhooks.revokeDescription: The token stops working immediately and every delivery using it will fail. It cannot be reactivated: create another credential to keep sending.
